title: 第九章 送上门的长耳定光仙第十章 九龙岛四仙破储物禁制
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
一路无话，片刻后，李玄霄已然来到藏经阁前。
没有想象中的白发老道，今日轮值看守藏经阁的是一位身着月白道袍、长耳垂肩的中年修士。
这人是……
李玄霄当即想起了眼前这人的身份。
截教内门弟子、随侍七仙之一的长耳定光仙。
未来封神量劫时，这长耳定光仙临阵叛教，盗走通天教主的六魂幡，投了西方教，是个趋炎附势、主动叛教的万恶之辈。
如今，这长耳定光仙乃是太乙金仙境界，在截教内地位颇高，且此前石矶曾说过，此人与马元素来交好。
李玄霄心中当即暗道一声不妙，今日入这藏经阁恐有麻烦了。
心中思绪百转，李玄霄面上却不露半分异样，走上前对着长耳定光仙躬身行礼，双手递上多宝给的青色玉牌：“记名弟子李玄霄，见过定光仙师兄。弟子欲往藏经阁借阅典籍，还请师兄放行。”
长耳定光仙垂着那双异于常人的长耳，眼皮半抬，斜睨了李玄霄一眼，嘴角微微上扬了三分。
这藏经阁是由几个内门弟子轮值看守，他正百无聊赖之际，见得这李玄霄到来，想到多宝讲道那天的事情，便道：“哦？李玄霄？听说你炼化了风雷仙杏，倒是好机缘。”
这话一出，李玄霄心中立马笃定，对方定是要阻自己进藏经阁了。
李玄霄做好了最坏的准备，不卑不亢道：“师弟我不过机缘巧合得了仙杏，又蒙三霄师姐引荐，多宝大师兄垂怜，这才顺利炼化了风雷仙杏，不敢当师兄夸赞。”
长耳定光仙闻言不搭话，只接过了那枚多宝所赠的青色玉牌，却话锋陡然一转，“这枚青色玉牌等同外门弟子之身份，但你不过只是记名弟子，怎会有此青色玉牌？”
李玄霄眉头微不可察地一蹙。
“你这令牌，恐不是从哪里捡的、偷的亦或是借的？这青色玉牌来历不正，我不可放师弟你进藏经阁。”
长耳定光仙图穷匕见，笑道。
此刻，李玄霄和马元之间有没有摩擦不重要，他长耳定光仙只是在享受权利，享受这种为难其他人所带来的异样快感。
在长耳定光仙的想象中，这李玄霄应该当即慌了神，然后不断解释、不断求饶，苦苦哀求自己放他进去。
但李玄霄注定要让他失望了。

李玄霄不卑不亢道：“定光仙师兄，这青色玉牌之上，是多宝大师兄亲手打下的烙印，师兄一看便知，绝无半分虚假。”
长耳定光仙把玩着令牌，丝毫没有放行的意思，反而抬眼盯着李玄霄，眼神里带着几分贪婪：“其实你要想进去，也不需要这青色玉牌。你此前既得了仙杏机缘，是否还有其他的？你且拿出来一两样，师兄我便睁一眼、闭一只眼，放你进去便是了。”
好家伙，这长耳定光仙终于说到了正题，拦下自己的最终目的，只是为了一些“人事”。
李玄霄乃后世穿越之人，又熟读西游，对于这种讨要人事的情况倒也熟悉。
那么这东西，要给吗？
若按照本心，李玄霄自不会给，甚至还要好好教训一番这长耳定光仙。
但眼下这位可是实打实的太乙金仙，自己不过天仙初期，要硬怼，着实不智。
content_en:
There was silence all the way, and after a while, Li Xuanxiao arrived in front of the Sutra Pavilion.
Instead of the white-haired old Taoist as expected, the man on duty today guarding the Sutra Pavilion is a middle-aged monk wearing a moon-white Taoist robe with long ears and lop shoulders.
This person is...
Li Xuanxiao immediately remembered the identity of the person in front of him.
Chang Er Dingguang Immortal, an inner disciple of the Jie Sect and one of the Seven Immortals.
In the future, when the Gods are consecrated to measure the tribulation, the Long-eared Dingguang Immortal betrays the religion on the battlefield, steals the Six Soul Banners of the Tongtian Cult Leader, and joins the Western Sect. He is an evil person who follows the trend and actively rebels against the religion.
Nowadays, this Long-eared Dingguang Immortal is in the realm of Taiyi Golden Immortal and has a high status in the Jie Sect. Shi Ji has said before that this person is on good terms with Ma Yuanlai.
Li Xuanxiao immediately thought to himself that it was not good, he might be in trouble if he entered the Sutra Pavilion today.
Thoughts were swirling in his mind, but Li Xuanxiao didn't show anything strange on his face. He stepped forward and bowed to the Long-eared Dingguang Immortal, and handed over the blue jade plaque given by Duobao with both hands: "Named disciple Li Xuanxiao, I have met senior brother Dingguangxian. I want to borrow books from the Sutra Pavilion, please let me go."
Long-eared Dingguangxian lowered his unusually long ears, half-raised his eyelids, glanced sideways at Li Xuanxiao, and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
This Sutra Pavilion was guarded by several inner disciples on duty. When he was bored, he saw Li Xuanxiao arriving. Thinking of what happened on the day Duobao gave his sermon, he said, "Oh? Li Xuanxiao? I heard that you refined the Fenglingxianxing, which is a good opportunity."
As soon as these words came out, Li Xuanxiao was immediately convinced that the other party was trying to prevent him from entering the Scripture Pavilion.
Li Xuanxiao was prepared for the worst, and said neither humble nor arrogantly: "Junior brother, I only got the Immortal Apricot by chance, and was recommended by Senior Sister Sanxiao. Senior Brother Duobao took pity on me, so I successfully refined the Fengling Immortal Apricot. I don't dare to praise it as a senior brother."
Long-eared Dingguang Immortal didn't say anything when he heard the words. He only accepted the cyan jade token given by Duobao, but the conversation suddenly changed, "This cyan jade token is equivalent to the status of an outer disciple, but you are just a registered disciple, how can you have this cyan jade token?"
Li Xuanxiao frowned imperceptibly.
"Is it possible that you picked up this token somewhere, stole it, or borrowed it? The origin of this cyan jade token is not correct. I cannot let you enter the Sutra Storage Pavilion, junior brother."
The long-eared Dingguang Immortal Tuqiong saw it and said with a smile.
At this moment, it doesn't matter whether there is any friction between Li Xuanxiao and Ma Yuan. He, Long Er Dingguangxian, is just enjoying his rights and the strange pleasure brought by embarrassing others.
In Chang'er Dingguangxian's imagination, Li Xuanxiao should have panicked immediately, and then kept explaining, begging for mercy, and begging himself to let him in.
But Li Xuanxiao was destined to disappoint him.
Li Xuanxiao said without being humble or arrogant: "Senior brother Dingguangxian, on this cyan jade plaque is the imprint made by senior brother Duobao himself. Senior brother can tell at a glance that it is absolutely not false."
Long-eared Dingguangxian played with the token and had no intention of letting it go. Instead, he raised his eyes and stared at Li Xuanxiao with a bit of greed in his eyes: "Actually, if you want to go in, you don't need this green jade token. Since you have had the opportunity of the fairy apricot before, do you have any others? Just bring out one or two, and I will turn a blind eye and close my eyes, senior brother, and let you in."
Good guy, this long-eared Dingguangxian finally got to the point, and his ultimate goal was to stop him just for some "personnel matters."
Li Xuanxiao was a person who traveled through time in later generations and was familiar with Journey to the West, so he was familiar with this situation of asking for help.
So do you want to give this thing?
If he followed his true intentions, Li Xuanxiao would not give it to him, and would even teach the long-eared Dingguang Immortal a lesson.
But right now, this person is a real Taiyi Golden Immortal. He is only in the early stage of the Immortal stage, so it would be unwise to fight him hard.
